contact.name: Elizabeth Weglein
contact.evidence_quote: Elizabeth Weglein ... Elizabeth Weglein serves as the chief executive officer of the Elizabeth Cooney Personnel Agency. The granddaughter of the agency’s founder and namesake, Elizabeth’s passion for the family business dates back to the childhood. Today, she not only upholds her family’s strong tradition of service, but she has forever strengthened the industry as an advocate for higher standards in recruitment, training and licensing. Remaining committed to the three basic tenets upon which the company was founded
